new_libraries.name: ZoneStarIoT
new_libraries.author: ZoneStar <support@zonestar.tech>
new_libraries.sentence: Connect ESP32 devices to the ZoneStar IoT cloud platform (MQTT/TLS) with a clean, typed device API.
new_libraries.paragraph: Register typed devices (switch, light, fan, thermostat, lock, blinds, garage), wire up callbacks for incoming commands, and report state changes back -- ZoneStarIoT handles WiFi, MQTT/TLS connection management, JSON parsing, reconnection/backoff and per-device topic routing automatically. Modeled after the Sinric Pro Arduino SDK's API shape.

library.name: libsdi12
library.author: Phillip Weinstock
library.sentence: The most complete, portable SDI-12 v1.4 protocol library.
library.paragraph: Pure C implementation covering every command in the SDI-12 v1.4 specification. Supports both sensor (slave) and master (data recorder) roles with zero dependencies. No malloc, no HAL — hardware abstracted via callbacks. Includes beginner-friendly macros (sdi12_easy.h), 165 unit tests, and works on any platform: Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Cortex-M, Linux, Windows. See sdi12_easy.h for a quick-start API.
